notes: Wiosna is the season when nature wakes up, usually starting in late March in Poland. In Polish, months are masculine, but the names of the seasons are feminine.
People often use the instrumental case when talking about the season: 'wiosną' (in spring).
Don't confuse this with 'wczesna wiosna' (early spring), which is often used to describe the chilly, muddy period before the flowers bloom.
